name: ClinicalTrial-ClaimCheck
description: ClinicalTrial-ClaimCheck is a claim-level benchmark for studying faithfulness in LLM-generated clinical-trial summaries. It provides 500 human-verified atomic claims, each labeled with a support label (Supported, Unsupported, Contradicted, or Unverifiable) and, where unsupported, a hallucination type (outcome exaggeration, safety, population, mechanism, or other), verified against the source trial record. The release also includes the full construction pipeline: 254 clinical trials from ClinicalTrials.gov across five therapeutic areas (cardiovascular, diabetes, mental health, oncology, respiratory), 508 audience-adaptive summaries (patient and clinician) generated with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, 5,811 atomic claims decomposed with Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, silver labels for detector training, the annotation guidelines and taxonomy, and per-claim results for three faithfulness metrics (NLI, SummaC, MiniCheck), a fine-tuned reference detector, and a multi-agent verifier. Trial records are derived from ClinicalTrials.gov (U.S. National Library of Medicine, public domain). All annotations and derived files are released under CC BY 4.0.
